strings.Обычная просьба: «В Телеграме найди мне: A regular request: “Find Vasya's contact in Telegram for me”. Petya will find the search field, enter the name, and read the available results right from the window, without the Telegram API. Commands are also available by voice (in Russian): «введи текст …» (type text …), «нажми ввод» (press Enter), «нажми сохранить» (press Save), «клик 500 300» (click 500 300), «останови управление» (stop control). New commands: «нажми Ctrl+Shift+S» (press Ctrl+Shift+S; on Mac, Cmd+Shift+S), «прокрути вниз 5» (scroll down 5), «двойной клик 500 300» (double-click 500 300), «правый клик 500 300» (right-click 500 300), «перетащи 100 200 в 400 500» (drag 100 200 to 400 500), «переключись на приложение Safari» (switch to the Safari app). Also: cut, undo, redo, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, Delete. Coordinates are measured from the top-left corner of the main screen. Emergency stop: Ctrl+Shift+F12 (⌘+Shift+F12 on Mac). While actions run, a teal “Petya” cursor and a badge on the controlled window are visible. They let clicks pass through and disappear when done. Access persists after a restart. “Stop control” disables both the current access and its restoration.
